title: 基礎パッド付き地上変圧器
description: 公共設備や工業地区向けの無銘・静的な油入変圧器の外観。基礎パッド、据付脚、油槽、通風隙間のある側面冷却フィン、背面リブ、上面の碍子端子、閉じた保護サービスキャビネットを造形しています。端子・キャップは外観のみで、接続配線・内部油・巻線・図面はありません。実機の設計、通電機能、定格、感電・防火安全性、設置基準の適合性は一切示しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.860 × 1.996 × 1.747 m、30,200三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An unbranded static exterior of a utility oil-filled transformer for public-service and industrial scenes. Includes a concrete pad, mounting skids, tank, side cooling banks with actual air gaps, rear ribs, top insulated terminals and a closed protected service cabinet. Terminals and caps are visual only; connected wiring, internal oil, windings and electrical diagrams are omitted. This supplies no operational electrical function, equipment design, rating, shock/fire safety claim or installation-standard compliance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.860 × 1.996 × 1.747 m; 30,200 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
